title: Topic 19
japanese_text: 入社10年目となり、周りから判断を<u>委ねられる</u>ことが増えた。経験を<u>踏まえて</u>仕事ができるし、助言を<u>仰げば</u>いつも<u>理に適った</u>アドバイスをくれる上司もいる。<u>欲</u>を言えば、頑張りに<u>見合う</u>給料がほしいものだ。
english_translation: I've been with the company for 10 years now, and more and more people are entrusting me with decisions. I perform my job based on my experience, and I have a boss who always gives me advice that makes sense, whenever I ask for it. If I had to wish for something, I suppose I'd like to receive a salary commensurate with my hard work.
